# Travel + Leisure

> > Travel + Leisure is a premier travel publication offering destination guides, hotel recommendations, and travel gear reviews to help readers plan memorable trips worldwide.

The site features expert-tested product reviews from editors like Jasmine Gomez, Chaise Sanders, and Patricia Doherty, along with comprehensive destination guides covering locations from California coastal towns to global ski resorts. Travel + Leisure combines practical travel advice with shopping recommendations for clothing, footwear, and luggage.

## Key Topics

- Destination guides and travel planning
- Hotel recommendations and reviews
- Travel gear and luggage testing
- Amazon shopping guides
- Spring fashion and capsule wardrobes
- Travel shoes and podiatrist advice
- California destinations (Los Angeles, San Diego, Marina del Rey)
- Ski resorts and outdoor adventures
- Travel essentials and packing tips
- Wrinkle-free and linen clothing
- International carry-on luggage
- Charleston and Oaxaca hotels
- Travel insurance guidance
- Healthy lifestyle destinations
- Seasonal travel timing

## Destination Guides

- [Twentynine Palms, California, Travel Guide](https://www.travelandleisure.com/twentynine-palms-california-travel-guide-11913161): California desert town guide featuring artists, chefs, and stargazing
- [The Essential Guide to Marina del Rey, California](https://www.travelandleisure.com/guide-marina-del-rey-california-11914725): L.A. beach town guide: waterfront hotels, beaches, sunset cruises
- [Vail, Colorado, Travel Guide](https://www.travelandleisure.com/guide-to-vail-colorado-11913150): Vail ski town guide: Bavarian village, Sonnenalp Hotel, outdoor activities
- [When to Visit Maine: Lobster, Savings, and Fewer Crowds](https://www.travelandleisure.com/best-time-to-visit-maine-7553282): Maine seasonal travel guide covering lobster season and fall foliage
- [Swimming With Leopard Sharks in La Jolla](https://www.travelandleisure.com/leopard-sharks-jolla-san-diego-11921388): La Jolla leopard shark snorkeling guide, 2 hours from Los Angeles

- [20 Best Ski Resorts Around the World](https://www.travelandleisure.com/best-ski-resorts-in-the-world-11887510): Global ski resort rankings: Jackson Hole, Powder Mountain, Alps, Japan
